00133 long int basis_term_index( long int dim_in, long int deg_in, long int *vec_in )
00134 {
00135         long int i,j,dcl = 0,idx = 0;
00136         for(i=0;i<dim_in;i++)
00137                 dcl += vec_in[i];
00138         if(dcl>deg_in)
00139                 return -1;
00140         for(i=dim_in-1;i>=0;i--) // start at most significant digit
00141         {
00142                 dcl = deg_in; // calculate the degree ceiling
00143                 for(j=i+1;j<dim_in;j++)
00144                         dcl -= vec_in[j];
00145                 if(dcl<0)
00146                         return -1;
00147                 for(j=0;j<vec_in[i];j++)
00148                         idx += basis_poly_dim( i, dcl - j );
00149         }
00150         return idx;
00151 }

00153 int basis_term_exponent( long int dim_in, long int deg_in, long int idx_in, long int *exp_out )
00154 {
00155         long int i,j,sum,tmp,tdx = idx_in,tdg = deg_in;
00156         if( idx_in >= basis_poly_dim( dim_in, deg_in ) )
00157                 return -1;
00158         for(i=dim_in-1;i>=0;i--)
00159         {
00160                 sum = 0;
00161                 for(j=0;;j++)
00162                 {
00163                         tmp = basis_poly_dim( i, tdg - j );
00164                         if( sum + tmp > tdx )
00165                         {
00166                                 // set exp_out[i] = j + 1;
00167                                 exp_out[i] = j;
00168                                 tdg = tdg - j;
00169                                 tdx = tdx - sum; // sum BEFORE adding tmp!!!
00170                                 break;
00171                         }
00172                         else
00173                                 sum += tmp;
00174                 }
00175         }
00176         return 0;
00177 
00178 }

00187 double basis_term_integral_simplex( long int dim_in, long int *exp_in )
00188 {
00189         long int num = 1,dnm = 0;
00190         long int i,j;
00191         for(i=0;i<dim_in;i++)
00192         {
00193                 num *= factorial( exp_in[i] );
00194                 dnm += exp_in[i];
00195         }
00196         dnm += dim_in;
00197         return (double) num / (double) factorial( dnm );
00198 }

00205 int basis_gen_coeffs( basis_t *basis_in )
00206 {
00207         long int i,j,k,dim = basis_in->dim,pdim = basis_in->pdim,deg = basis_in->deg,exp[dim];
00208         double *nodes = basis_in->nodes,mat[pdim*pdim],*tmp;
00209 
00210         /* Allocate basis_in->coeffs */
00211         tmp = (double*) malloc( pdim * pdim * sizeof(double) );
00212         if( tmp == NULL )
00213                 return -1;
00214         basis_in->coeffs = tmp;
00215 
00216 #ifdef SEMSOLVE2_BASIS_USE_LAPACK
00217         int n = (int) pdim,info,ipiv[pdim];
00218 #else
00219         dmatrix_t dmat,rmat;
00220 #endif
00221 
00222         /* Make the righthand side unity matrix */
00223         for(i=0;i<pdim*pdim;i++)
00224         {
00225                 if( i % pdim == i / pdim )
00226                         basis_in->coeffs[i] = 1.0;
00227                 else
00228                         basis_in->coeffs[i] = 0.0;
00229         }
00230 
00231         /* Make the Vandermonde matrix */
00232 #ifndef SEMSOLVE2_BASIS_USE_LAPACK
00233         for(j=0;j<pdim;j++)
00234         {
00235                 /* Form the function exponents */
00236                 basis_term_exponent( dim, deg, j, exp );
00237                 for(i=0;i<pdim;i++)
00238                 {
00239                         /* Now evaluate it at interpolation node i */
00240                         mat[i*pdim+j] = 1.0;
00241                         for(k=0;k<dim;k++)
00242                                 mat[i*pdim+j] *= powf( nodes[i*dim+k], (double) exp[k] );
00243                 }
00244         }
00245 
00246         /* Set up lefthand side data structure */
00247         dmat.start = mat;
00248         dmat.rsize = pdim;
00249         dmat.nrows = pdim;
00250         dmat.ncols = pdim;
00251 
00252         /* Set up righthand side data structure */
00253         rmat.start = basis_in->coeffs;
00254         rmat.rsize = pdim;
00255         rmat.nrows = pdim;
00256         rmat.ncols = pdim;
00257 
00258         /* Here, use the basic LU linear solver */
00259         dmatrix_lu_dcmp( &dmat );
00260         dmatrix_fb_sub_mrhs( &dmat, &rmat ); /* This function still needs to be written */
00261 #else
00262         for(j=0;j<pdim;j++)
00263         {
00264                 /* Form the function exponents */
00265                 basis_term_exponent( dim, deg, j, exp );
00266                 for(i=0;i<pdim;i++)
00267                 {
00268                         /* Now evaluate it at interpolation node i */
00269                         mat[j*pdim+i] = 1.0;
00270                         for(k=0;k<dim;k++)
00271                                 mat[j*pdim+i] *= powf( nodes[i*dim+k], (double) exp[k] );
00272                 }
00273         }
00274 
00275         /* Here using lapack */
00276         dgesv_( &n, &n, mat, &n, ipiv, basis_in->coeffs, &n, &info );
00277 #endif
00278         return 0;
00279 }

00332         /* Here, use the basic LU linear solver */

00335 #else

00346                 }

00364 int basis_func_gradient( basis_t *basis_in, long int fidx_in, double *loc_in, double *grad_out )
00365 {
00366         long int i,j,k,exp[basis_in->dim],dim = basis_in->dim,pdim = basis_in->pdim,deg = basis_in->deg;
00367         double prd;
00368 
00369         /* For each variable with which to differentiate */
00370         for(i=0;i<dim;i++)
00371         {
00372                 /* For each polynomial term in function fidx_in */
00373                 grad_out[i] = 0.0;
00374                 for(j=0;j<pdim;j++)
00375                 {
00376                         basis_term_exponent( dim, deg, j, exp );
00377                         if( exp[i] > 0 )
00378                                 prd = (double) exp[i] * powf( loc_in[i], (double) ( exp[i] - 1 ) ); /* This is the term to differentiate */
00379                         else /* Since the exponent is 0, then the derivative vanishes */
00380                                 prd = 0.0;
00381                         for(k=0;k<dim;k++)
00382                                 if( k != i )
00383                                         prd *= powf( loc_in[k], (double) exp[k] );
00384 #ifdef SEMSOLVE2_BASIS_USE_LAPACK
00385                         grad_out[i] += basis_in->coeffs[fidx_in*pdim+j] * prd;
00386 #else
00387                         grad_out[i] += basis_in->coeffs[j*pdim+fidx_in] * prd;
00388 #endif
00389                 }
00390         }
00391 
00392         return 0;
00393 }

00408 double basis_plane_test( long int dim_in, long int nplpts_in, double *simpx_in, long int *plane_in, double *point_in )
00409 {
00410         int i,j;
00411         int n,nrhs;
00412         int ipiv[dim_in+1];
00413         double sum;
00414         double vdm[dim_in*dim_in+2*dim_in+1];
00415         double rhs[dim_in+1];
00416 
00417         // make the Vandermonde matrix
00418         for(i=0;i<dim_in+1;i++) // column-major -> row = function = component, column = point
00419                 for(j=0;j<dim_in+1;j++)
00420                         vdm[(dim_in+1)*i+j] = ( i == 0 )?( 1.0 ):( simpx_in[j*dim_in+i-1] );
00421 
00422         // make the righthand side
00423         for(i=0;i<dim_in+1;i++)
00424                 rhs[i] = 1.0;
00425         for(i=0;i<nplpts_in;i++)
00426                 rhs[plane_in[i]] = 0.0;
00427 
00428         n = (int) dim_in + 1;
00429         nrhs = 1;
00430         dgesv_( &n, &nrhs, vdm, &n, ipiv, rhs, &n, &i );
00431         sum = 0.0;
00432         for(i=0;i<dim_in+1;i++)
00433                 sum += ( i == 0 )?( rhs[i] ):( rhs[i] * point_in[i-1] );
00434         return sum;
00435 }

00441 void basis_barycentric( long int dim_in, double *point_in, double *simp_in, double *bary_out )
00442 {
00443         long int i,j;
00444         double mat[dim_in*dim_in];
00445         int n = (int)dim_in,nrhs = 1,ipiv[dim_in],info;
00446 
00447         /* Making the T matrix */
00448         for(i=0;i<dim_in;i++)
00449                 for(j=0;j<dim_in;j++)
00450                         mat[j*dim_in+i] = simp_in[j*dim_in+i] - simp_in[dim_in*dim_in+i];
00451         for(i=0;i<dim_in;i++)
00452                 bary_out[i] = point_in[i] - simp_in[dim_in*dim_in+i];
00453         dgesv_( &n, &nrhs, mat, &n, ipiv, bary_out, &n, &info );
00454         bary_out[dim_in] = 1.0;
00455         for(i=0;i<dim_in;i++)
00456                 bary_out[dim_in] = bary_out[dim_in] - bary_out[i];
00457 }
